headline: Going Commando reaches 12.76% and builds three releases from shared C
summary: Going Commando's USA v1.01 matched code rose from 9.13% to 12.76%, with 4,138 of 8,601 entries reported finished, including original assembly. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. PAL and USA v2.00 join as build targets, with separate progress reports and release-specific C.
highlights: The final report commit gives PAL 3,550 of 8,693 finished functions and USA v2.00 3,940 of 8,655.
#282 adds 471 PAL and 310 USA v2.00 implementations. #286 adds another 12 and two respectively.
#283 adds 48 functions, while other batches cover shared lists, Yeedil and game routines.
#249 restores assembly for four candidates that depended on artificial barriers, retaining their clean C as near misses.
#252 adds strict builds that fail when C silently falls back to original assembly.
Compiler and assembler corrections resolve #247 and #248. Further catalogue cleanup changes the total counted.
